scope: Topology of ledger-listed armed actors resolved from active base YAML. Host inventory covers all concrete active base actors, not only ledger entries. Slot names and host selectors do not establish cargo compatibility, exclusivity or simultaneous fire. Factors exclude conditional modifiers; host conditions, ports, range, reload, armor and runtime uptime are not simulated. Activation is a conservative assumed zero-condition snapshot, not actual spawn state; compound expressions remain unknown. Weapon-only passes are not actor eligibility or proposals. No armaments removed, no damage summed, no gameplay changes.
